# Origin service Moon landing fixture

This 27,023-byte save was produced by an actual native Moon descent using the
existing deterministic C++ world, seed42, physical catalog2. It is a supported
occupied Wayfarer landing at simulation tick30580, with its original versioned
travel, resource and knowledge owners. SHA-256: `c90be1fe1b04c3fb0878baef0ef461d95eaaf26d43ebf15792d4717ebd6daeea`.

The fixture retains the original player fuel and has no service actor. Rescue
